title: Design System: Edge AI Training Lab

shadows.name: printed-frame
shadows.purpose: Double inset rule on scientific plates and folio panels.

motion.name: training-pulse
motion.purpose: Training indicator only; reduced-motion preference suppresses animation.

components.name: Train Button
components.description: Main experiment action in the right-hand column.
components.css: .ds-btn-train { width: 100%; min-height: 72px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 4px double #f6e7d4; outline: 1px solid var(--red-dark, #842218); background: var(--red, #ad3023); color: #fffaf1; font: 700 23px/1.1 "Zen Antique Soft", Georgia, serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-btn-train:hover { background: var(--red-dark, #842218); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-train:active { transform: none; } .ds-btn-train:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #165d9f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-train:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Stop and export actions below the status panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 39px; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #86765d); background: var(--paper, #f8f2e0); color: var(--ink, #211b14); font: 700 13px/1.45 Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--paper-deep, #efe5cc); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--paper-deep, #efe5cc); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #165d9f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Dataset Select
components.description: Visible list for choosing the experiment data.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-dataset">Choose training data</label><select class="ds-dataset" id="ds-dataset" size="4"><option selected>XOR classification</option><option>Circle classification</option><option>Spiral classification</option><option>Sine wave fitting</option></select>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; color: var(--ink, #211b14); font: 700 13px/1.45 Georgia, serif; } .ds-dataset { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #86765d); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper, #f8f2e0); color: var(--ink, #211b14); font: 13px/1.45 Georgia, serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dataset option { padding: 8px 9px; min-height: 32px; } .ds-dataset option:checked { background: #dce9d4; color: var(--green, #1e6841); font-weight: 700; } .ds-dataset:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #165d9f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-dataset:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Scientific Plate
components.description: Numbered figure frame for network or dataset visualization.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; min-width: 0; padding: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #86765d); background: rgba(248,242,224,.66); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 5px var(--paper, #f8f2e0), inset 0 0 0 6px rgba(134,118,93,.7); color: var(--ink, #211b14); font-family: Georgia, serif; } .ds-plate-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #86765d); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-plate-diagram { padding: 14px 7px 7px; text-align: center; } .ds-plate-diagram span { display: inline-block; width: 33%; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-plate-caption { padding: 12px 12px 5px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(134,118,93,.6); text-align: center; font: italic 15px/1.35 Georgia, serif; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact label for the actual training state.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--green, #1e6841); background: #dce9d4; color: var(--green, #1e6841); font: 700 12px/1.2 Georgia, serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; }

components.name: Folio Index
components.description: Compact links to the lab sections.
components.html: DataNetworkTrainingResults
components.css: .ds-index { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-index a { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--ink, #211b14); text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .13em; font: 700 12px/1.2 Georgia, serif; } .ds-index a:hover, .ds-index a:focus-visible { border-color: var(--rule, #86765d); background: var(--paper-deep, #efe5cc); } .ds-index a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #165d9f); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width:720px) { .ds-index a { padding: 7px 4px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .04em; } }

components.name: Training Progress
components.description: Small status track with actual progress value.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #86765d); background: var(--paper, #f8f2e0); } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; width: 35%; background: var(--green, #1e6841); }

narrative.overview:
This document applies only to the standalone Edge AI Training Lab at `static/apps/edge-ai-sandbox.html`. It does not define the visual system for dennisjcarroll.com or the surrounding Gatsby site.

The lab presents an experiment as an illustrated technical folio. Warm uncoated paper, engraved rules, editorial serif type, and paired scientific plates make the network and data readable as related observations. Color has a bounded job: red identifies the main action and one data class, blue identifies the other class and focus, and green identifies active or successful state. This is the approved Neural Field Guide direction represented by `.impeccable/mocks/option-2.webp`; the implementation is the source for values and behavior.
keyCharacteristics: A paper field with double rules and inset plate borders.
A large network plate beside a data plate, with a narrower action column on wide screens.
Typographic labels, figure numbers, and quiet captions around live graphics.
Immediate, visible training state with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Bounded Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep red, blue, and green attached to actions, data, and state. Let paper and ink carry the reading surface.

rules.name: The Figure Label Rule
rules.body: Use small uppercase labels and numbered captions to orient a graphic; preserve the plot and model as the main content.

rules.name: The Paired Plate Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, keep topology and data at comparable visual weight; on narrow screens, stack them after the immediate experiment controls.

rules.name: The Printed Frame Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with rules and paper tone; do not turn the folio into elevated dashboard cards.

rules.name: The Truthful State Rule
rules.body: Keep idle, training, stopping, and completed states tied to actual experiment state; never present placeholder metrics as measured results.

dos: Do preserve the paired figure hierarchy and label each representation clearly.
Do use the observed paper, ink, and rule tokens for new lab panels.
Do keep keyboard focus visible in scientific blue and honor reduced-motion preference.
Do show unavailable results as unavailable until training produces them.
donts: Don't extend this document's tokens to the Gatsby site without a separate design decision.
Don't replace the folio with equal-weight neon dashboard cards; the selected direction rejects that look.
Don't use color alone to distinguish classes, training state, or comparison models.
